<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ClaimHandling" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/claim-handling" exporter="BPMN Modeler" exporterVersion="1.0">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendationNeeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimOkCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendationNeeded" name="Recommendation to write">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimOkCheck" name="Claim marked as OK?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendationNeeded" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimOkCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOkCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOkCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationNeeded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_ClaimHandling">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_ClaimHandling" bpmnElement="Process_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer_di" bpmnElement="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="150" y="100" width="800" height="150"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer_di" bpmnElement="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="150" y="250" width="800" height="150"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered">

      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_ExamineClaim_di" bpmnElement="Task_ExamineClaim">

      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Gateway_RecommendationNeeded_di" bpmnElement="Gateway_RecommendationNeeded" isMarkerVisible="true">

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_CheckRecommendation_di" bpmnElement="Task_CheckRecommendation">

      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Gateway_ClaimOkCheck_di" bpmnElement="Gateway_ClaimOkCheck" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="790" y="295" width="50" height="50"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds">
        <dc:Bounds x="900" y="302" width="36" height="36"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_1_di" bpmnElement="Flow_1">

      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_2_di" bpmnElement="Flow_2">

        <di:waypoint x="490" y="170"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_4_di" bpmnElement="Flow_4">

        <di:waypoint x="690" y="170"/>

      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_7_di" bpmnElement="Flow_7">

      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
